## Summary

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build or CI
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Refactor

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm validate`
- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`
- [ ] Docker/Compose behavior validated when affected

## Security and operations

- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or private material were added to source control.
- [ ] GitHub Actions permissions remain least-privilege.
- [ ] Docker/runtime user and filesystem permissions remain secure.
- [ ] Dependency or supply-chain impact was reviewed when dependencies/actions changed.
- [ ] User-facing, operational, or architecture-impacting documentation was updated when needed.

## Release impact

- [ ] No release impact.
- [ ] Release notes/changelog impact reviewed.
- [ ] Migration or rollback considerations documented.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change scoped and maintainable.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-facing or architecture-impacting changes.
- [ ] I added or updated ADRs for long-lived design decisions.
- [ ] I considered observability, reliability, and failure modes.
